en.html:
I was indoors. A farmhouse of some kind, presumably.

I lay under an unfamiliar quilt on an unfamiliar floor. To speak plainly, it was extremely hard. But it was warm.

I took inventory of my body. Bandages around the chest, wound somewhat tight. Not the way one wraps a bruise. Probably the way one wraps after heavy bleeding.

Now, then. When and where had I acquired a wound of that kind—

……家の中だ。
　どこかの百姓家だろうか。

　見覚えのない床の上、見覚えのない布団の中に寝か
されている。
　<ruby>有体<rt>ありてい</rt></ruby>に言って、ひどく硬い。だが温かくはあった。

　己の全身を知覚する。
　……胸に包帯を巻かれているようだ。ややきつめに
締めてある。打撲傷ではなく、おそらく激しい出血を
した際の巻き方。

　さて。
　そのような負傷をいつ、何処で――

The girl stood and ran to the chest of drawers. The man who sat down in her place looked over my whole body with quiet eyes. Stuck to his back, another girl peeped out, perhaps three or four years younger than the first.

Our eyes met. She gave me a shy smile.

I had no procedure prepared for this.

en.html:
ふな"Ooooh!"
弥源太"...Look. When he was brought here, this was a severe open wound. New tissue has already formed over it. A warrior's recovery is a terrible thing."
ふき"H-how is that...?"
弥源太"This is the power of an armor that is no counterfeit. A true armor, carrying the soul of its smith, is not easily broken. Small losses it restores by its own strength, without trouble."
弥源太"And a warrior and armor joined by the Tatewaki rite are always one. The restoring power reaches the warrior's body also. As you see."
ふき"So that is how... Wow..."
Kageaki"Even so, without your help I would have been killed before I could recover. I must still thank you."
弥源太"You are not a man whose star is to die at the hands of a magistrate and his hangers-on. And Mido, I only did what was natural."
Kageaki"..."
弥源太"When you stopped that fool at the mountain work site, I was standing there too. The savior of our village lies fallen, I see him, and I do nothing? Is there such a law?"
Kageaki"I did that for personal reasons. To call it salvation makes me shrink."
弥源太"Maybe so. Still, when one is helped, one gives thanks. Is that not natural also?"
Kageaki"..."

en.html:
As I had thought. True to the ageless Emishi, he looked at most a man in his prime. But the weight in every movement, and the address he used, Mido, told his real age.

Mido is an old-fashioned honorific for warriors, which few people use any more. It comes from the fact that the court's warriors' hall once stood in a building called Shakutendo.

弥源太"So you are police, then."
Kageaki"I am grateful for your cooperation. This debt I will certainly repay later..."
Kageaki"For today, I will take my leave shortly."
ふき"Eh!? But— you cannot! Impossible!"
弥源太"...I praised your recovery earlier. Even so, for a night you will not be moving. Force the body and the wound opens again."
Kageaki"But I cannot impose on you. If I stay, this body will not only take up floor space—"
弥源太"You are worried about the magistrate's men? I see. So that wound came from a fight with them, and you think pursuers may follow."
Kageaki"Precisely."
弥源太"That worry is unnecessary. Suppose we throw you out. These men stop troubling us, is it?"
Kageaki"That is..."
弥源太"As long as they are here, trouble is here for the village. Personal reasons or whatever reasons, Mido, if you are going to deal with them, helping you benefits the village."
Kageaki"..."
弥源太"Rest here one full day. For a man like you, that should likely be enough for a full recovery."
ふき"Please, stay. Difficult matters I don't understand, but injured like this and walking out—no, that is not allowed."
ふな"Hmm? Didi, what happened to Bhaiya?"
ふき"Bhaiya says he wants to go home."
ふな"Nooo! I don't like that! I want him to stay more..."
ふき"Right? See, warrior sahib? Even Funa says so."

弥源太 「警察の人であったか」
景明 「御協力に感謝致します。 　この御礼は後日必ず……」
景明 「今日のところは、そろそろ失礼させて頂き ます」
ふき 「えっ!? 　そんな……無理ですよ！」
弥源太 「……さっきは回復が早いと褒めたがな。 　流石に一晩は動けんだろうよ。無理をして 動けばまた傷口が開くぞ」
景明 「しかし、ご迷惑は掛けられません。 　自分がここに留まれば、この図体で場所を 塞ぐのみならず――」
弥源太 「代官どものことを案じておるのか？ 　なるほど……やはりその傷はやつらと一戦 交えた結果か。それで追手が来るかもしれぬ と言うのだな」

景明 「それは……」
弥源太 「やつらはいる限り村の迷惑よ。 　一身上の都合だろうが何だろうが、御堂、 なれがやつらを成敗するというのなら、なれ を助けることは村の利益に適う」

ふな 「えーっ、そんなのやだ！ 　もっといてほしい……」

en.html:
Being told that was no argument. ...Still, I could not see myself pushing through the pair of them and leaving.

And as Elder Yagenta said, forcing myself out now offered neither advantage nor reason. Accepting their kindness seemed the wiser course.

ja.html:
言われても。
　……しかし、これを振り切って行くことはできそう
になかった。

　それに弥源太老人の言う通り、今無理を押して出て
いく選択にはどうも利もなければ理もないらしい。
　ここは厚意に甘えておくのが賢明だろうか。
